browser_notes: Final workflow-catalog and workflow-sync runs cover the history invalidation and retry-focus changes. Commands, queue and controls suites passed earlier in this slice; the final changes were confined to history cache/focus and unknown-count presentation.

The last unknown-count fallback (an em dash instead of zero before a successful history read) was validated by the final UI suite after browser captures. It does not change the captured populated or retained-result layouts.
Desktop coverage: 1024 and 1440 pixels, light and dark, 100% and 200% text; 8 configurations. Scroll-page retry controls were scrolled into view before checking keyboard focus and bounds.
The isolated history browser scenario made no POST requests or external model calls. Other established suites intentionally exercise synthetic writes in disposable fixtures.
test_helper_corrections: Existing catalog mocks/interception paths were updated for the definitions-only URL; the sync VM gained document listeners for the new history event bindings.
The detail-back test now waits for selected to be cleared rather than accepting the prior detail state as a ready list.
The slow-response route waits for its fulfillment before removing interception, avoiding a Playwright double-handling error.
The enlarged-text reachability check scrolls the long ordinary page before focusing the retry control; final screenshots reset to the filter header.
Space switching intentionally lands on the workbench, so the isolation test explicitly returns to workflow history before asserting the empty new scope.
The command-only VM supplies the workflow history accessor used by the new complete-results action.

benchmark.comparison: Original latest 100 full workflow states versus new first page of 50 headers; not equal payloads and not a production load guarantee.

release: Source only; existing release artifacts unchanged.
